movelist.name: Safeguard
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Safeguard may activate it when receiving a Status Affliction to ignore the effects of that Status Affliction on their next turn. Safeguard may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Dragon Rush
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 3 meters. Dragon Rush Flinches the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Dragon Tail
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 6 meters minus their Weight Class. On a roll of 15+, the target is also Tripped.

movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Inner Focus
abilities.effect: The user cannot be Flinched, and their Initiative cannot be unwillingly lowered by any effects.

abilities.name: Courage
abilities.effect: While at or under 1/3rd of its Max Hit Point value, the user gains a +5 Damage Bonus to all Damage Rolls, and 5 Damage Reduction. Defensive.

abilities.name: Confidence
abilities.effect: Choose a Combat Stat. All allies within 5 meters of the user gain +1 CS in the Chosen Stat.
